desc: Derive a feasibility characterization for which vectors \((d_0,\ldots,d_N)\) are realizable as indegrees, exploiting the cycle-plus-apex structure.
Convert the characterization into an \(O(N)\), constant-state transfer DP that counts distinct degree sequences and handles the wraparound cycle edge.
Prove the DP counts each degree sequence exactly once, including collisions between different orientations.
Exhaustively enumerate orientations for small \(N\) and compare with the DP, including all-zero, all-one, and mixed spoke patterns.
Implement the verified algorithm in Python with \(O(N)\) time and memory-conscious processing, modulo \(998244353\), using the required stdin/stdout format and code delimiters.
